verdict.rationale: Graphite documents AI review customization through custom rules and comment exclusions, but the evidence never says these live in a versioned config file in the repo. Path filters, per-path instructions and review profiles are also never mentioned. Setup is described as a few clicks with no configuration, so the in-repo config-as-code core of this story is unevidenced; the customization features are adjacent at best.

support.subject: As an engineering lead, I configure the reviewer with a versioned config file in my repo — path filters, per-path instructions, review profiles
